title: Retire disposable enable-timing control sessions during failed-sample unwinding
outcome: A failed disposable Verify/Save timing sample cannot leave its Engram control children running into the next predeclared sample.
acceptance: The enable-timing fixture explicitly shuts down the exact control sessions it started on both normal return and unwinding, reusing the existing control-session cleanup pattern without touching another sample or live data.
Source review and a focused failure-path witness establish that cleanup occurs before the next sample begins; no latency threshold or product behavior changes are introduced.
